items.title: Nord Stream trial opens in Germany, defense seeks dismissal
items.description: Serhii Kuznietsov is accused of attacking civilian infrastructure in the 2022 sabotage of the Russian gas pipeline to Germany. His lawyers called Nord Stream a military target, and said their client is sworn to secrecy.

items.title: Trump announces plans for major oil, gas and mineral exploration in Greenland
items.description: The US president has claimed Greenland holds vast and easily accessible oil reserves without providing evidence or details. His announcement follows a deal expanding the US military presence on the Arctic island.
